items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: The trombone players with Schroeder, George, they read good in the Singleton. ... I sound pretty good in that band.

ctx.x: Yeah, and the drum player couldn't play at all. The piano player was pretty good. The trombone players with Schroeder, George, they read good in the Singleton. They couldn't read anything but they couldn't play all the music. I got a tape on it and I sound pretty good in that band.
This is the band all went to that elementary school? All of the children did, yeah. Oh, all of the children.
